{{Quote|Lim Paddu has quietly supported our Resistance since the beginning, first with funds, later by persuading other aristocrats to our cause. She has a gift for cutting through ideological bickering with practical advice. She told one noble, ''If you support the Emperor, fine, but you own land on a dozen worlds&mdash;what if he blows them up too?'' Will you rescue Lim from certain execution?|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Lim Paddu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] aristocrat during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with locating Paddu and escorting her back to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Paddu spoke a clear form of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lim Paddu was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Players who performed a series of [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for [[W:c:swg:Pooja Naberrie|Pooja Naberrie]] had to locate Paddu and escort her safely back to [[W:c:swg:Dee'ja Peak|Dee'ja Peak]]. However, due to a bug, many of the NPCs in Naberrie's quests were not properly sequenced. For instance, in the quest to escort Paddu, players actually encountered a group of [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]], which were not intended to be a part of the quest (according to the quest dialogue). The character model for Lim Paddu likewise erroneously spawned for Naberrie's fourth quest, in which the player was supposed to encounter an individual named [[Turon Adala]].<ref name="AED" /> According to a forum guide on the official [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] discussion board, players could advance to the next quest by [[Death/Legends|killing]] the main female narglatch.<ref name="Rebel Quest Guide">{{WebCite|url=http://www.swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070130174548|text=''Rebel Quest Guide'' v1.01|archivedate=20160708155445}}</ref> This article assumes that the content of Naberrie's quest dialogue is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and that Paddu, not a group of narglatch, actually appeared during her fifth quest.<ref name="AED" />

The questline that involved Paddu was eventually removed from the game when Pooja Naberrie was relocated to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] as part of the newly introduced [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]], released as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
